cds.title: Macalester College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (CDS C1, read from the PDF's form fields): 8,819 applied (4,067 men, 4,738 women, 14 unknown), 2,481 admitted (995 + 1,478 + 8), 534 enrolled (232 + 300 + 2). The CDS leaves the in-state / out-of-state / international applicant and admit rows blank, so those are not shown; B2 gives 90 nonresident first-years enrolled. The ED figure is Early Decision (C21: 479 applications, 201 admitted). Macalester also has a non-restrictive Early Action round, whose counts are not in the table. The GPA table (C11) and average GPA (C12) are blank, so no GPA figures are shown. SAT/ACT is optional: 185 SAT submitters (published as 35%) and 128 ACT submitters (24%). The CDS lists the ACT composite 25th percentile as 29.75. Undergraduate enrollment (2,068) and the nonresident count (338) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1/B2; College Scorecard shows 2,131.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set (G1). The CDS ticks '2026-27 costs not available' (final costs due March 1, 2026), so these are the 2025-26 figures: tuition $70,632, required fees $230, on-campus food and housing $16,476 (housing $8,722 + meal plan $7,754); comprehensive fee $87,338. Tuition includes required course materials since 2024-25, so books are $0. 'Other expenses' $2,336 is listed under commuters not living at home only. Per-credit-hour tuition $2,207. CDS H6: 287 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $59,839 (total $17,173,928); the aid year ticked in H1 is unclear in the PDF text. The international FAQ says the Charles J. Turck Presidential Honor Scholarship (up to $40,000 a year) goes to a select number of international students.
